images.title: The patchwork room
images.purpose: Give the whole chapter on one picture: 8 small cards in the order of the chapter, one for each idea, each simple and countable, for the child to say one idea from each stop.
images.composition: A title, then 2 rows of 4 cards read left to right and top to bottom: border, tiles and area, unit square, same area, rectangle, square, missing side, tile edges.

labels: Count the tiles in their unit
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a card missing or added, or the cards in a different order
any number other than the ones listed in the captions
images.takeaway: Each stop of the chapter has one idea, and a number or a rule to say aloud.
images.description: A map of the chapter in 8 small cards: the border of a quilt, tiles and area, the unit square, same area, rectangle, square, missing side and tile edges.
images.context: Concept image for the Chapter Revision. It follows the idea of the chapter's pictures in your maths book and uses only the numbers of the chapter's own examples, never the numbers of a book question.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student say one idea from each card before reading the caption. The slip to watch: mixing up area and perimeter on the rectangle and square cards.

image_decisions.why: One picture of the whole chapter helps the revision lines and the short checks.
